verdicts.reason: docs/HISTORICO.md records a pre-build survey ("Levantamento antes de escrever código") with licensing constraints (AGPL coss-ui excluded because the product is private; Iconiq MIT), stack constraints, and the design-system constraint (Supernova palette over the shadcn preset). README's "Como está construído" table and src/design/preset/PRESET.md record stack and design-system constraints (Next.js 16/React 19/Tailwind v4 static export; single primitive family; only supernova.css may declare literal colour). ADR-001 names the single decider (team constraint).
